g.text: The two jobs that make a game a game
persistent state — come back and it is still there
rules — applied the same way for everyone
physics — things move, collide and fall as expected
real-time sync — thousands share one world
immediacy — the world reacts the moment you act
dust behind a car, smoke off a fire
the level of realism players now
Game engines are strong at ①, world models at ② — and nobody has done both cheaply
Graphics are the visible part; what makes a game a game is the system you cannot see
